{{Quote|As I said, an agent's life is dangerous. You never know when you might get caught up at the wrong end of a military action. The sort of action that might occur if a patrolling Star Destroyer happened on data pointing to a suspected pirate nest.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vak Somoril]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], about [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
The '''Bombing of Gepparin''' was a four-way conflict between the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[BloodScar]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], and the combination of members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Hand of Judgment]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] taking place on [[Gepparin]].

==Background==
{{Quote|You realize what you're suggesting. You're talking about killing an Imperial agent. A woman who gets her orders from Palpatine himself.|Captain Ozzel to Colonel Somoril, about Mara Jade|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
During her investigations about the [[BloodScar]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] infiltred the pirate ship ''[[Cavalcade]]'' and eliminated its crew, excepting the pilot [[Tannis (pirate)|Tannis]], during an attack on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Happer's Way]]''. She then called the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']] to help fix the ship, putting [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Ozzel]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vak Somoril|Somoril]] on edge, thinking that it was a trap to catch them after having an ISB [[Major/Legends|major]] killed and a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] deserting.

[[File:Mara_Jade_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|left|160px|[[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].]]

Mara planned to use the ''Happer's Way'' in order to infiltrate the [[BloodScar base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gepparin]] with Tannis and a couple of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] provided by the ''Reprisal''. [[Brock]] and [[Gilling]] were in fact two ISB agents assigned by Somoril to watch for the Emperor's Hand. Ozzel and Somoril intended to follow Jade and attack the pirate base with the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], conveniently killing Mara herself and covering the tracks of the offenses she didn't even realize they have committed.

In the [[Purnham system/Legends|Purnham system]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and [[Hand of Judgment]]'s ''[[Melnor Spear]]'' worked together to intercept a BloodScar ship. They used info from the interrogation of the prisoners to determine the BloodScars base location. The Hand of Judgment stormtroopers thinking that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], given his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], might be the mysterious Emperor's Hand, the joined force continues on its way to Gepparin to hunt down the pirate base.

==The battle==
{{Quote|You mentioned a patron earlier. I want his name.|Mara Jade, to [[the Commodore]]|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
Mara arrives at Gepparin with Tannis and her two ISB agents. Under the cover of having taken over Happer's Way for a group of pirates that wanted to link up with the BloodScars, she met the BloodScar leader, [[the Commodore]], and his second, [[Caaldra]]. Mara was later betayed the ISB agents, who revealed that they were trying to kill her to silence her knowledge of the defecting stormtroopers from the ''Reprisal'', and forced to kill them. She then faced off with the Commodore's men, with Tannis assisting her. Caaldra then tried to kill them both with a fire trap and Tannis was severely injured. The Commodore was escaping Mara when the entire base came [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|under attack]] from the ''Reprisal.''

[[File:Reprisal2.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']].]]

Moments later, the ''Melnor Spear'' with the damaged ''Millennium Falcon'' attached arrived at Gepparin. The Hand of Judgment freaked out, thinking that they have been discovered by the ''Reprisal''. Using the ''Falcon'' to set up an escape with only [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] aboard, they split up and evaded the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] capture. When the ''Millennium Falcon'' leaped for the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], the Star Destroyer followed it, leaving [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to finish up at the base.

At the base, Mara found the Commodore dead in a control room, but discovered that he was trying to contact his patron on [[Shelkonwa]], whom Mara believed to be Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard|Choard]]. When the TIE fighter attacked her, she was forced to destroy them, using the [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] of the base. Mara and Tannis tred to use the ''Happer's Way'' to leave the planet, but Caaldra who had survived the attack stole it and escaped. Tannis eventually died in Mara's arms.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Han, Leia's in danger. She's trapped in Makrin City on Shelkonwa, and the Empire knows she's there.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
Mara Jade found a [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 Seeker]] in the base and headed for Shelkonwa, briefly stopping along the way to leave Tannis' body in space as he had wished.

When the Rebels and the stormtroopers arrived as the base, they discovered the same information about the contact with Shelkonwa, so they decided to go there together, especially since Luke had sensed [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] was in danger there.
